embeddings.normalization: Unicode NFC; first 512 coordinates then L2 normalization
embeddings.queryPrefix: Represent the query for retrieving supporting documents:

runtime: llama.cpp b11865, Darwin x86_64 CPU, authenticated UNIX socket; no paid inference
cacheCandidates: One independently scoped cached question and YES answer per family; no cross-family competition in the cache diagnostic.
scores: MongoDB cosine score is (1 + cosine)/2; report raw cosine separately. Threshold comparison uses MongoDB score.
hypotheses: Identical cached question with a changed trusted policy revision can reuse an obsolete answer under a model-only key.
Trusted revision binding excludes changed-policy cache entries, while a polarity reversal within the same revision may still reuse an incompatible answer.
Raising a fixed similarity threshold may reduce both incompatible reuse and valid paraphrase hits; select no winning threshold from this authored fixture.
A memory correction must change the persisted embedding as well as direct and semantic value visibility; deletion must preserve the neighboring namespace.
cacheMeasures: Hits and incompatible YES reuse by variant/arm/threshold
Valid exact/paraphrase hit retention; report all cases and scores, including misses

adapterPlan.engine: Official pinned MongoDBAtlasSemanticCache and MongoDBStore; PostgreSQL exact-vector control if available
adapterPlan.memoryChecks: Capture persisted old/new embeddings and semantic values; require new embedding matches recorded replacement text, old state absent after visibility; delete tenant a, retain tenant b
adapterPlan.isolation: Only labeled disposable resources; no host-bound database ports or cloud credentials

interpretationLimits: Researcher-authored, explicitly paired questions and labels; not a population false-hit rate or independent human benchmark.
No generative LLM answer or autonomous extraction is run; YES/NO answers are authored cache fixtures.
Context binding uses trusted application metadata; namespace/filter tests are not a production authorization audit.
Score analysis and context-key oracle alone do not establish adapter runtime behavior; record database stages as unrun until executed.
No production readiness, comparative performance, cost or platform-winner claim.
